signatures.description: EduOS /quiz/<id>/take rendered 0 question blocks despite GET /api/v1/assessment/:id returning 200 with 3 questions. Root cause: legacy demo quiz rows have NO id/questionId/question_id on questions; the take page filters quiz.questions.filter(q=>q.id) and drops every question, submit then POSTs 0 answers and the API replies bare Validation failed. Fix: QuizService.get() backfills deterministic ids <quizId>:question:N for id-less legacy questions (shared by render/drafts/submissions/grading) plus inline per-question validation guidance blocking incomplete submits. Lesson: verify the live payload id-key shape BEFORE assuming a hydration bug.
